moa.t: Blocks β1 and β2 receptors, reduces portal pressure, tremor and thyrotoxic symptoms

items.t: Propranolol, oral, 20–40 mg 12 hourly. Titrate to resting pulse rate of 50– 60 beats per minute. Monitor pulse and BP.

Propranolol, oral, 2 mg/kg daily in 3 divided doses. · If needed, increase dose to 8 mg/kg/24 hours. · Aim to reduce the resting pulse rate by 25%.
